page.overview:
Who is Alien Hypno?

Alien Hypno is a character version of the card, "Alien Hypno".

Alien Hypno appears as a Tag Duel opponent in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008. Its Tag Partner is Lich Lord, King of the Underworld and their team name is First Contact. By beating them five times, it can unlock a Tag Team known as Counter Culture.
